subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this WeChat hot-reload fix show redacted live A+B QR-login evidence before merge, or is the gateway-level regression suite sufficient for this provider-backed lifecycle change?
rationale: The implementation and its stale-account guards are source-tested, but the contributor explicitly cannot exercise the live provider flow; only a gateway owner can set the acceptable proof threshold.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Obtain redacted evidence that adding account B through the real QR-login flow leaves the already-running account A online after the reload.

options.title: Accept gateway regression proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-level proof and merge on the focused lifecycle tests plus normal required checks, accepting the remaining provider-integration uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Obtain redacted evidence that adding account B through the real QR-login flow leaves the already-running account A online after the reload.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recently merged gateway reload-planner work is the closest demonstrated ownership signal in the supplied history.
